boundary: This contract freezes the evidence fields required before an authorised pilot. It is not a field baseline, operator agreement, permit, budget, service result, safety approval or deletion proof.

shared_rules.baseline_rule: Keep local baseline and observed performance unknown until an authorised team records a dated, versioned collection plan and evidence.
shared_rules.threshold_rule: Freeze the success threshold before field collection; do not import a paper, regional statistic or synthetic tabletop value as a local threshold.

baseline.observation_unit: grouped care and daily-service requests by service type, time window and accessibility category

sample_and_window.sample_definition: authorised team must pre-register the eligible request groups and inclusion/exclusion rules
exclusion_rules: exclude unconsented individual traces, requests outside the declared service group or time window, and people who cannot enter through the recruited intake route
record excluded categories without identifying individuals; absence from the recruited group is not evidence of no care or accessibility need
sample_and_window.sampling_method: pre-registered grouped observation; no continuous personal trajectory

success_condition.rule: Every applicable request keeps a human, telephone, paper or public-transport equivalent and can exit without a digital account.
success_condition.threshold: freeze before field collection; no local numeric value is claimed

stop_conditions: care or accessibility fallback is unavailable
a person cannot cancel or appeal through a human route
personal data is requested beyond the published purpose

accountability.operating_owner_role: community service and mobility liaison role
accountability.independent_stop_reviewer_role: accessibility, privacy and public-interest review role

human_equivalent.route: community service desk, telephone, paper request and ordinary public transport
human_equivalent.handover_record: record request group, handover time, alternative route and unresolved item

data_contract.retention_rule: retain only the minimum grouped record for the declared review cycle; exact period requires authorisation

deletion_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: declarative receipt schema only; it does not prove that deletion has occurred

review_and_redress.review_cycle: before each window, after the first replay and at the declared close-out review; dates unknown
review_and_redress.appeal_entry: staffed desk, telephone or paper complaint route
review_and_redress.appeal_owner_role: community liaison and independent review roles
review_and_redress.response_owner_role: community liaison role with independent review escalation
review_and_redress.response_sla: freeze a response window before authorisation; current service level is unknown
review_and_redress.response_rule: publish receipt ID, received time, owner, status, next review time and lookup location; exact service level requires authorisation

appeal_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: a declared receipt format does not prove that an appeal was received or answered

baseline.observation_unit: dated route walk-throughs by route segment, handover point, weather state and accessibility group

sample_and_window.sample_definition: authorised accessibility reviewer must pre-register route segments, handover points and observation strata
exclusion_rules: exclude route segments inaccessible to the declared audit method, users not represented by the assisted-route sample, and unconsented individual traces
record excluded route conditions and do not infer safe access from a route or user group that was not observed
sample_and_window.sampling_method: professional route audit plus grouped assisted-route replay; no unconsented individual tracking

success_condition.rule: The declared route remains continuous, understandable and assisted by a human or ordinary public-transport route for every applicable group.
success_condition.threshold: freeze the route-level and worst-group threshold before field collection; no local accessibility result is claimed

stop_conditions: a lift, ramp, crossing or clear route is unavailable without a verified fallback
the worst-group route is not recorded or cannot be completed safely
an undated audit is presented as an accessibility result

accountability.independent_stop_reviewer_role: independent accessibility and safety review role

human_equivalent.route: staffed assistance, telephone coordination and a verified ordinary public route
human_equivalent.handover_record: record route segment, assistance offered, obstruction, weather state and return action

data_contract.retention_rule: retain the minimum route-audit and aggregate assistance record through the declared review cycle; exact period requires authorisation
data_contract.deletion_owner_role: data stewardship and accessibility review roles

deletion_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: declarative receipt schema only; it does not prove that deletion has occurred

review_and_redress.review_cycle: before each window, after any route change or incident and at the declared close-out review; dates unknown
review_and_redress.appeal_entry: staffed route desk, telephone or paper complaint route
review_and_redress.appeal_owner_role: accessibility review and community liaison roles
review_and_redress.response_owner_role: accessibility review role with independent safety escalation
review_and_redress.response_sla: freeze a response window before authorisation; current service level is unknown
review_and_redress.response_rule: record receipt ID, received time, owner, status, next review time and route remedy; exact service level requires authorisation

appeal_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: a declared receipt format does not prove that an appeal was received or answered

baseline.observation_unit: grouped enterprise demand, vehicle class, curb asset and declared arrival/loading window

sample_and_window.sample_definition: authorised team must pre-register participating demand groups, vehicle classes, curb assets and exclusion rules
exclusion_rules: exclude unconsented enterprise identities, vehicles or curb assets outside the declared window, and demand groups not represented in the grouped ledger
record out-of-scope demand categories rather than treating unobserved enterprise or resident demand as zero
sample_and_window.sampling_method: grouped demand and curb observation; no enterprise identity or personal route trace

success_condition.rule: A reversible window is opened only when the curb owner, human dispatcher, fire route and accessible route are all recorded; the ordinary public route is not displaced.
success_condition.threshold: freeze the window-level compliance and route-protection threshold before field collection; no local capacity result is claimed

stop_conditions: complaint or curb asset has no accountable owner
a shuttle, loading action or reservation blocks a fire or accessible route
vehicle, headway or clearance evidence is absent

accountability.operating_owner_role: enterprise mobility coordinator and curb operations role
accountability.independent_stop_reviewer_role: transport, fire and accessibility review role

human_equivalent.route: manual booking, on-site human marshal, ordinary public curb rules and public transport
human_equivalent.handover_record: record curb asset, reservation state, clearance action, fallback and unresolved complaint

data_contract.retention_rule: retain minimum grouped demand and curb-state records through the declared review cycle; exact period requires authorisation

deletion_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: declarative receipt schema only; it does not prove that deletion has occurred

review_and_redress.review_cycle: before each reservation window, after any blockage or complaint and at the declared close-out review; dates unknown
review_and_redress.appeal_entry: on-site human marshal, telephone or paper complaint route
review_and_redress.appeal_owner_role: curb operations and community liaison roles
review_and_redress.response_owner_role: curb operations role with independent fire/accessibility escalation
review_and_redress.response_sla: freeze a response window before authorisation; current service level is unknown
review_and_redress.response_rule: freeze the reservation and publish receipt ID, received time, owner, status, next review time and lookup location when a complaint is unresolved; exact service level requires authorisation

appeal_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: a declared receipt format does not prove that an appeal was received or answered

baseline.observation_unit: grouped arrival and transfer requests by station exit, time window, mode and accessibility need

sample_and_window.sample_definition: authorised team must pre-register station exits, transfer modes, time strata and protected-route checks
exclusion_rules: exclude unconsented individual traces, station exits or transfer modes outside the declared window, and protected groups not represented by the assisted-wayfinding sample
record excluded exits and groups; an unobserved transfer is not evidence of a safe or reliable transfer
sample_and_window.observation_period: to_be_frozen before the first transfer replay
sample_and_window.sampling_method: grouped transfer observation and human wayfinding replay; no continuous personal trajectory

success_condition.rule: A person can complete the declared last-mile choice with staffed wayfinding or ordinary public transport even when a digital recommendation is unavailable.
success_condition.threshold: freeze the transfer-level completion and worst-group threshold before field collection; no local reliability result is claimed

stop_conditions: the feeder shifts a protected group onto an unsafe crossing or blocked route
station, curb or transfer owner is not assigned
transfer reliability is presented without dated grouped observation

accountability.independent_stop_reviewer_role: transport, accessibility and public-safety review role

human_equivalent.route: staffed wayfinding, ordinary rail/bus transfer and telephone information
human_equivalent.handover_record: record station exit, transfer choice, assistance, fallback and unresolved gap

data_contract.retention_rule: retain minimum grouped transfer records through the declared review cycle; exact period requires authorisation
data_contract.deletion_owner_role: rail/bus operations and data stewardship roles

deletion_receipt_contract.semantic_boundary: declarative receipt schema only; it does not prove that deletion has occurred

review_and_redress.review_cycle: before each transfer window, after any route change or incident and at the declared close-out review; dates unknown
review_and_redress.appeal_entry: staffed station desk, telephone or paper complaint route
review_and_redress.appeal_owner_role: rail/bus operations and community liaison roles
review_and_redress.response_owner_role: rail/bus operations role with independent accessibility escalation
review_and_redress.response_sla: freeze a response window before authorisation; current service level is unknown
review_and_redress.response_rule: record receipt ID, received time, owner, status, next review time, lookup location and alternative route; exact service level requires authorisation
